title: 10x check is not reporting
description: Alerts when the log10x integration has stopped submitting its heartbeat, which means the Agent check is no longer running or no longer scheduled.

definition.name: [log10x] Check is not reporting on {{host.name}}
definition.message:
The log10x Agent check on `{{host.name}}` has not reported for 10 minutes.

To resolve:
1. Run `datadog-agent status` on the host and look for `log10x` under Running Checks
2. Confirm `conf.d/log10x.d/conf.yaml` exists and the Agent has been restarted since it was created
